newsitem.title: USA: DeVry seeks to add campus near San Francisco.
newsitem.headline: DeVry seeks to add campus near San Francisco.

text.p: DeVry Inc on Thursday said it was seeking approval from the state of California to open a DeVry Institute of Technology in the San Francisco Bay area.

The company said it recently bought 16.7 acres of land in Fremont, California, as part of an expansion of its educational system. DeVry hopes to build a 100,000-square-foot building on the site and offer classes in Fremont in 1998.
DeVry is also scheduled to add as many as four campuses in the next two years.
The company offers bachelor's degree programs in a variety of high-tech and business administration subjects.
Its shares were up 1/4 at 23-7/8 early Thursday afternoon.
